questions.question: Describe how you would plan and deliver a two-week sprint to add a new customer data feed when the mapping is still evolving. How would you break down the work, manage changes, and demonstrate progress?
Give an example of a repetitive engineering or operational task you identified and automated. What was manual before, what did you build, and how did you measure reliability or time saved?
This position requires legal authorization to work in the country of application. Are you currently authorized to work there, and will you now or in the future require employer sponsorship?

A production load completes successfully, but downstream users report that record counts and totals no longer reconcile. Walk through your incident triage, containment, root-cause analysis, correction, and stakeholder communication.
Before creating a pipeline for an unfamiliar source system, what profiling queries and checks would you run, and how would those findings affect the target design and load logic?
How would you turn a business requirement such as “standardize customer status across incoming feeds” into a data mapping specification that another engineer could implement and test?

For a new automated ETL job, which validation controls would you implement at ingestion, transformation, and target-load stages? Explain the failure thresholds and what would happen when a check fails.

Suppose a provided DQ rule requires every active customer to have a valid identifier and a referenceable master record. How would you enforce it, quarantine exceptions, report them, and prevent repeat issues?

When an existing application must consume a modified JSON or Kafka feed, how do you assess schema compatibility, manage versioning, handle malformed messages, and deploy the change safely?
